violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Cases of raw meat stored on floor of walk in cooler.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. -Tubes of raw hamburger stored above whole muscle meat in walk in cooler. -Tubes of hamburger stored above pork chops in display case. COS-Rearranged while on-site.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Wet cloth left at counter top between uses. Changed out and/or rinsed "a few times a day".

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -Cheese case (commercial packed items) found with ambient temp of 47-50.5F. *Directed owner to move items to different refrigeration and/or ice product until unit is fixed. Service tech is expected/planned for 05/15/26.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door. -Bathroom door open at time of inspection and does not self-close.
